dedupe_keys.name: modelling storage operation for markets participation and supply of advanced system services

description: Canevese, S. and colleagues document this resource through an ISGAN report deposited in Zenodo. The work employs a dynamic-response model and stochastic optimization procedure to size and manage battery energy storage for single and combined grid services. Simulations mainly follow Italian market rules and Grid Code specifications, distinguishing power availability payments from payments for exchanged energy. The model assesses service performance, cycling ageing and owner profitability. Small energy exchanges can make activation-only power services unattractive; the outcome depends on remuneration and energy prices. The authors explicitly identify bid-acceptance uncertainty and competitive bidding strategies as requiring further analysis. Coverage is limited to the stated battery-service simulations. This is an implemented study model, without a verified standalone code package or independently identified related dataset. Historical market assumptions are not presented as current tariffs. The report is openly available under CC-BY-4.0; these terms do not establish a software licence or public source-code release. Full descriptive metadata and file inventories were inspected. The PDF and any code or data bodies were not opened, and the calculations were not reproduced.
